title: Task sync shared notes: opt-in note round-trip with stable note identity and origin-machine provenance
outcome: Task sync shared notes: opt-in note round-trip with stable note identity and origin-machine provenance
acceptance: Opt-in generic and status notes round-trip between two isolated stores with original note id, author, time and an operator-supplied origin-machine value unchanged, and re-export is byte-identical

Engram-stored gate, host verification, environment, evaluation, execution-observation and path-binding records, and notes containing locators or machine/user paths, are absent from the export, with visible omission counts and reasons proven by a test seeding each stored family. Export uses a typed allow-list admitting only shared note bodies, so host-only records such as retained prompts have no route into the export; no host-private counts are claimed
A legacy note without a note id is reported as excluded and never given a fresh id; an altered id/body pair on import is refused and leaves the target unchanged
No durable-store migration and no TermAl remote relay are introduced

completion.summary: Delivered opt-in generic/status shared-note directory round-trip with stable original ids, author/time/asserted machine provenance, inert imported history, counted typed exclusions, legacy no-id omissions, atomic known-id drift refusals, and unchanged durable schema/projections. Exact-input full gate and complete Codex+Claude round8 passed; independent acceptance4/4; no acceptance criteria changed for completion. Two Low follow-ups independently filed. Installed clean landed build and all4 stores ready.
